name: devpost-hackathon-cli
description: Prototype Devpost hackathon guide for Codex CLI with terminal-native text output.

interface.shortDescription: A terminal-native Codex CLI hackathon guide
interface.longDescription: Prototype Devpost hackathon plugin for Codex CLI: orientation, rules review, resources, optional guided learning, submission drafting, and final preflight with compact text progress indicators and no image dependency. It intentionally stops short of direct Devpost submission while sponsor, legal, and event copy are still being finalized.
defaultPrompt: Start my Devpost hackathon flow in Codex CLI.
Show my hackathon map and next step.
Show the next deadline and what I should do before submitting.
